model.checkpoint_provenance: Community export of model-2000.pt; training fold and manifest not established. No pickle loaded.

protocol.input: Pinned WAV -> librosa mono 22050 Hz float32 kaiser_best -> author RMS normalization. No gain tuning.
protocol.frontend: Whole-file HCQT: harmonics 0.5,1,2,3,4,5; E2 fmin; 144 bins; 36 bins/octave; hop 512; gamma 0. Each harmonic amplitude_to_db(ref=max, top_db=80)/80+1. Author expected-frame count; nine-frame windows, four zero-padded frames at either end.
protocol.decoding: Float32 Torch sigmoid of raw tablature, then argmax of 21 classes per string minus 1. Silence first; frets 0..19; open pitches 40,45,50,55,59,64. No 0.5 gate, duration filter, bend or onset postprocessing.
protocol.time: Offline nominal frame i*512/22050 to (i+1)*512/22050, nearest native sample, clipped at recording EOF; no fitted timing shift. Whole-file normalization and centered context are noncausal.
protocol.labels: Scoring only after model outputs saved; no relabeling or exclusion. Model range 40..83; ALL annotations remain primary denominators.
protocol.comparison: Distinct pitch occupancy, no string assignments or unison multiplicity. Same-pitch overlap/touch union for both detectors. Existing saved CURRENT baseline reproduced before comparison.
protocol.primary: FretNet alone. Ordinary pitch-coverage gain >=5 percentage points; both corpora no wrong-pitch or gap-output growth, no all-expected/exact-set duration loss. Report strict per-label zero loss and separately frozen budget: present and longest loss <=25 ms AND <=5% of own CURRENT value, no newly entirely missed label.
protocol.report_only: Literal CURRENT union FretNet; fixed pitch split CURRENT<60 plus FretNet>=60. Full per-label rows, first-present delay, bands, false and gap counts retained even on rejection. Not promotion candidates.
protocol.reference_gates: Two pinned real author-runtime reference bundles, three raw heads allclose atol=rtol=1e-4, decoded positions exact; framing exact; HCQT allclose 1e-4; times abs<=1e-6; chunk128 vs full logits/decoded identity. Any failed reference gate stops BEFORE corpus inference.
protocol.baseline_configuration: Saved collision-enabled CURRENT at block512, A4=440, trim=-9, sensitivity60, response75, maxpoly5, maxfret24. Independently configured from the upstream model defaults; not a controlled production-policy comparison.
